title: Orphaned future-work direction from W4389520749 (2023)
explanation: Future-work item from openalex:W4389520749 (2023) is unaddressed by any later corpus paper through 2026 (3 yrs). 49 later topically-near papers exist and none addresses it (two-stage matcher). Item: "Extend hallucination detection evaluations to broader domains beyond biography passages, such as locations and objects.". CORPUS-RELATIVE CAVEAT: 'orphaned' means unaddressed WITHIN this 113-paper corpus, not the field; the two-stage matcher's precision is limited (P≈0.64) and the corpus is a sample, so this is a weak, corpus-relative signal — not evidence the field ignored it.

consumer.headline: Extend hallucination detection evaluations to broader domains beyond biography passages, such as locations and objects.
consumer.kind_short: A question a paper said needed studying, that nothing else in this library followed up on
consumer.kind_long: When researchers finish a paper they usually name the questions they could not get to. We collected those, then checked whether any later paper in this library actually went and did the work. These are the ones where nothing did.
consumer.strength_meaning: There is real evidence behind this, but it rests on a small number of papers — read them before trusting it.
consumer.why: A paper said this needed studying. That was 3 years ago. Since then 49 later papers in this library worked on closely related topics, and none of them took this up.

caveats.label: Only checked within these 113 papers
caveats.text: Nothing in this library followed this up — but this library is 113 papers, not the whole field. Somebody outside it may well have answered this already. Check before you invest.

caveats.label: Based partly on summaries only
caveats.text: For some of these papers we only had the summary, not the full text. Papers we could read in full reveal far more about their own limits, so this may be built on an incomplete picture.
